en.name: FHI Statistics (Norwegian Institute of Public Health)
en.description: Norwegian public health statistics from FHI's registers and statistics banks: key figures from Norgeshelsa and Kommunehelsa, the prescription register, the cause of death register, the vaccination register, communicable diseases and more. Pick a source, a table and values per dimension; the measures live in the dimension MEASURE_TYPE. Texts are in Norwegian.
en.notes: Cite the source: Norwegian Institute of Public Health.
